concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingestion of the CTU‑13 dataset, but the plan explicitly substitutes the open‑source NetFlow dataset (`keys-i/netFlow`). This violates the functional requirement and the specification’s dataset assumption.

The plan validates the constructed graph against `contracts/graph.schema.yaml` but never validates the raw NetFlow records against `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`. Contract coverage is incomplete, leaving the raw data unchecked.
